title: A Little World of Happiness

shots.image: wide cinematic establishing shot of {HOME} in the evening, warm lights glowing in the windows, birds flying home across a golden sky, butterflies over the flowers
shots.motion: slow drone-like push towards the house, leaves swaying, ducks gliding on the pond
shots.sfx: soft evening birds, leaves rustling, gentle stream, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: My story began in a simple, happy home.

shots.image: {GIRL6} chasing butterflies in the front garden of {HOME}, ducks by the pond, seen from behind
shots.motion: the girl runs and twirls after a butterfly, tracking camera at child height
shots.sfx: children's laughter, birds, ducks quacking, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: We were an ordinary middle-class Indian Muslim family, but our home was full of warmth.

shots.image: {AMMI} cooking at the stove in a warm kitchen with steel utensils, {GIRL6} beside her helping roll dough, side view
shots.motion: steam rises from the pot, the mother stirs, the girl rolls a small roti, gentle push-in
shots.sfx: sizzling pan, steel utensils, glass bangles clinking, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: We didn't have everything, but we never felt that something was missing.

shots.image: {GIRL6} sitting on the courtyard steps watching colourful birds in the mango tree, {DADI} smiling nearby, seen from behind
shots.motion: birds hop between branches, the girl points up, slow tilt up into the tree
shots.sfx: birdsong, leaves, distant household sounds, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Family meals, little games, familiar voices and the love of my parents made my childhood special.

shots.image: {AMMI} standing in the glowing doorway of {HOME} calling towards the garden at dusk, seen from the side
shots.motion: the mother waves her hand to call the child inside, warm light spilling out
shots.sfx: evening crickets, door creak, no music

lines.speaker: AMMI_HI
lines.text: Aa jao beta, khana tayyar hai!
lines.tts_text: आ जाओ बेटा, खाना तैयार है!

shots.image: {GIRL6} and {BHAI} playing with a small ball in the garden at dusk, the girl turning her head towards the house
shots.motion: the girl holds up one finger towards the house and keeps playing
shots.sfx: children playing, ball bouncing, crickets, no music

shots.image: {ABBU} opening the small garden gate of {HOME} at dusk carrying a cloth bag, greeting the family with a gentle salaam gesture, seen from behind
shots.motion: the father walks up the path, the girl runs to hug him
shots.sfx: gate creak, footsteps on gravel, happy giggle, no music

shots.image: the family sitting together on a dastarkhwan floor cloth with steel plates of halal food, {ABBU}, {AMMI}, {DADI}, {BHAI} and {GIRL6}, warm lamp light, seen from a gentle high angle
shots.motion: hands pass bowls, everyone settles to eat
shots.sfx: plates and spoons clinking, soft family murmur, no music

lines.speaker: ABBU_HI
lines.text: Chalo, sab saath mein khana khate hain.
lines.tts_text: चलो, सब साथ में खाना खाते हैं।

shots.image: {GIRL6} at night sitting on the floor of her cosy room beside a small stack of schoolbooks, a folded prayer mat and a Quran resting on a wooden stand on a high shelf, soft lamp light, seen from the side
shots.motion: the girl touches the books curiously
shots.sfx: quiet night crickets, ceiling fan hum, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Back then, I had no idea what life had planned for me.

shots.image: close view of the little stack of schoolbooks beside {GIRL6}'s small hands, warm lamp glow
shots.motion: the camera slowly moves towards the books
shots.sfx: quiet room, a page turning, no music

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: I was simply enjoying my little world.
